subject: Status: eval results + backbone variance risk
body:
Status on evaluation.

Research mode: on our 40-question internal benchmark the agent's cited reports check out well — citation-support rate (does the cited page actually support the sentence) is 91% with the primary backbone profile, and the search-visit-cite loop rarely dead-ends now that Halima capped revisits.

Equity slice: DCF outputs are reproducible run-to-run once we pinned the WACC assumptions in the profile. Comps selection is the weak spot — it occasionally pulls a peer from the wrong sector — so Paloma is encoding sector guardrails as a bundled skill, which the discovery precedence picks up with no code changes.

Risk: backbone variance. The same prompt through the two configured profiles differs materially in report depth; for the pilot we should pin one profile and say so, or Idris's team will read variance as unreliability.

Serving: the SSE endpoint is stable on staging.

Wei
